title: Blow-up for a Semilinear Tricomi-type Equation with Scale-Invariant Mass in the Oscillatory Regime
summary: We investigate the finite-time blow-up of solutions to a Tricomi-type equation with scale-invariant potential and power nonlinearities in the oscillatory regime. For smooth, compactly supported, nonnegative initial data, we prove nonexistence of global-in-time solutions when the power nonlinearity lies below the positive root of an explicit Strauss-type polynomial naturally associated with the equation.
